news.headline: uniQure shares slide further as investors brace for AMT-130 four-year data
news.summary: uniQure stock kept falling into the last week of September, closing near $42.76 on September 23 (down 5.57% on the day, roughly 40% below its 52-week high) and sliding further intraday toward $39.80, as investors trimmed positions ahead of the closely watched four-year AMT-130 Huntington's disease data update guided for release by September 30. The pullback also reflects a broader risk-off tone in biotech tied to rising rate-hike concerns, even though the balance sheet remains strong.

news.headline: uniQure submits BLA to FDA and MAA to UK MHRA for AMT-130 in Huntington's disease
news.summary: uniQure announced submission of a Biologics License Application to the FDA seeking accelerated approval of ifezuntirgene inilparvovec (AMT-130) based on the 3-year Phase I/II dataset, and requested priority review; the company simultaneously filed a Marketing Authorisation Application with the UK's MHRA for the same therapy.

catalysts.label: AMT-130 four-year Phase I/II topline data (Huntington's disease)
catalysts.detail: uniQure has guided that 48-month follow-up data on AMT-130 (12 high-dose and 12 low-dose patients, plus 3 additional high-dose patients with 3-year follow-up), benchmarked against an expanded ~26,000-patient Enroll-HD external-control cohort, will be released before the end of September 2026. This is the key near-term binary catalyst and will supplement the 3-year data already filed with the FDA.

catalysts.label: FDA decision on BLA filing acceptance / priority review
catalysts.detail: Following the September 2, 2026 BLA submission requesting priority review, the FDA's standard ~60-day filing review would conclude around early November 2026, determining whether the application is formally accepted and whether priority review (6-month clock) is granted.

catalysts.label: Potential FDA target action date for AMT-130
catalysts.detail: If the BLA is accepted under priority review, a target FDA decision date would fall around Q2 2027; no PDUFA date has been confirmed by the FDA yet.

catalysts.label: UK MHRA decision on AMT-130 Marketing Authorisation Application
catalysts.detail: uniQure filed a parallel MAA with the UK's MHRA on September 2, 2026; no review timeline or decision date has been disclosed yet.

catalysts.label: AMT-260 (epilepsy) updated Phase I/IIa data
catalysts.detail: uniQure expects to complete enrollment of the second dose cohort for AMT-260 in refractory mesial temporal lobe epilepsy in Q3 2026 and present updated Phase I/IIa results in the first half of 2027.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings and company update
catalysts.detail: Based on uniQure's typical quarterly cadence (Q2 results were reported July 29, 2026), the next earnings release and pipeline update would be expected around early November 2026; no confirmed date yet.

pulse: uniQure is in the final stretch before its guided September 30, 2026 deadline for four-year AMT-130 topline data in Huntington's disease, a binary catalyst that will supplement the three-year dataset behind the accelerated-approval BLA filed with the FDA (and the parallel MAA filed with the UK's MHRA) on September 2, 2026. The stock has sold off sharply into the readout, closing near $42.76 on September 23 and dipping toward $39.80 intraday (roughly 40% below its 52-week high), amid broad biotech risk-off sentiment, even though the balance sheet is solid with roughly $810 million in cash as of June 30, 2026, funding operations into 2030. Beyond AMT-130, earlier-stage programs AMT-260 (epilepsy) and AMT-191 (Fabry disease) continue to advance, with the next AMT-260 update expected in the first half of 2027.
